Swiftness (op)(op): Until the start of your next turn, increase the TN of techniques targeting you by 1.

vehicle.name: Rapid Transit
vehicle.flavor: Efficiency in movement is a tactical advantage. An operator who knows how to optimize routes, anticipate obstacles, and maintain momentum can cover ground faster than anyone expects, turning distance into a manageable variable rather than a constraint.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As a downtime activity, if you have a vehicle available, you may make a TN 2 Piloting (Fortune) check to reach a destination with extreme swiftness.

Effects:

If you succeed, you reach the destination in half the time it would normally require. Passengers in your vehicle are automatically included in this rapid travel.
opportunities: Fortune (op): You may lead a number of willing characters with vehicles of their own up to your ranks in Piloting.

vehicle.name: Chicken
vehicle.flavor: Two vehicles on a collision course. Whoever blinks loses ground. If neither does, both cars eat the closing speed. The one with the heavier frame walks away less broken.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As a Scheme action during a chase, make a TN 3 Resolve (Power) check targeting one opposing driver you can perceive.

Effects:

If you succeed, the target driver gains 3 strife and must immediately choose:
• Blink: Decelerate, gaining 1 stack of Losing Ground.
• Hold the line: Both vehicles collide head-on. Each vehicle suffers damage equal to the current scene speed (minus that vehicle's armor value). All occupants of both vehicles suffer a Critical Strike. The severity equals the current scene speed, shifted by half the difference in the two vehicles' damage thresholds (rounded down in favor of the heavier vehicle). Minimum severity 1.

vehicle.name: PIT Maneuver
vehicle.flavor: The rear quarter panel of a vehicle is a lever. One tap in the right place spins the target with its own momentum. Physics does not give them a choice.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As an Attack and Movement action during a chase while at range 0 of a target vehicle, make a TN 3 Piloting (Precision) check.

Effects:

If you succeed, the target driver must resist with a Piloting check (TN 4, Swiftness 2, Resilience 5). On failure, the target vehicle gains 2 stacks of Losing Ground and the driver suffers the Dazed condition. On success, they gain 1 stack of Losing Ground instead.
opportunities: Precision (op)(op): If the effect would cause the target to reach 3 or more stacks of Losing Ground, they are instead violently knocked out. All occupants suffer a Critical Strike with severity equal to the current scene speed.

vehicle.name: Ride the Line
vehicle.flavor: Every driver has a limit. Most discover it by crossing it. Skill helps you stay on the road. Nerve keeps your foot in the throttle when every instinct says brake.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

When you fail a Piloting check during a chase, you may spend 1 Fortune Point.

Effects:

You do not gain a stack of Losing Ground from this failure. If the check was an Attack action, you may immediately move 1 range band in any direction as a free action.
opportunities: Fortune (op)(op): Treat the failed check as if it succeeded with 0 bonus successes instead. This technique can still only be applied once per failed check.

vehicle.name: Rolling Fortress
vehicle.flavor: A vehicle parked between your team and incoming fire is better than any wall you could build in the same time. Steel body panels and an engine block absorb rounds that would otherwise find flesh.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As a Support action during a skirmish while you are driving a vehicle, position the vehicle as cover. Make a TN 2 Tactics (Resilience) check.

Effects:

If you succeed, the vehicle provides cover until it moves:
• Characters on the far side of the vehicle from incoming fire add double your vehicle's armor value to their physical resistance.
• Occupants inside the vehicle add your vehicle's armor value to their physical resistance.

vehicle.name: Thread the Needle
vehicle.flavor: Most drivers see a gap and wonder if they fit. You see the same gap and wonder if you need to slow down. Spatial awareness at speed is training, paid for in paint transfers and close calls.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As a Movement action during a chase, make a Piloting (Swiftness) check. The TN equals the current scene speed.

Effects:

If you succeed, you navigate through a space or obstacle that would normally be impassable. Reduce the TN of your next Piloting check to navigate a tight gap or similarly improbable maneuver this scene by your bonus successes (minimum 1). You do not gain Losing Ground this round from other drivers accelerating.
opportunities: Swiftness (op)+: One pursuing vehicle per (op) spent this way cannot follow you through the gap and must find an alternate route, gaining 1 stack of Losing Ground.
Swiftness (op)(op): You may immediately perform a second Movement action without spending an action.

vehicle.name: Ghost Ride
vehicle.flavor: Sometimes the vehicle is the weapon and you are the delivery system. Lock the wheel. Pick the line. Jump. Two tons of steel at speed does not care about armor.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As a Movement and Attack action during a chase, make a TN 3 Piloting (Fortune) check. Expend your vehicle (it is disabled or destroyed in the process).

Effects:

If you succeed, you safely exit the vehicle at range 0. The vehicle hurtles forward in a straight line up to 2 range bands. All characters and vehicles in this line suffer a Critical Strike with severity equal to double your vehicle's remaining damage threshold (its damage threshold minus its accumulated damage).
opportunities: Fortune (op): You may aim the vehicle toward a specific target you can perceive, extending its path to reach them if they are within 3 range bands.
Fortune (op)(op): The vehicle's wreckage counts as Dangerous and Obscuring terrain at its final position until the end of the scene.

vehicle.name: Push It to the Limit
vehicle.flavor: The manufacturer put a redline on the tachometer. You have never respected it. The engine screams, the frame shakes, and the gap changes. Whether it closes or widens depends on which side of the chase you are on.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

During a chase, as a Movement action, spend any amount of strife and deal an equal amount of damage to your vehicle (this damage bypasses armor). Then choose one: If you are chasing: Remove that many stacks of Losing Ground. If you are being pursued: Increase the scene speed by that amount. All other drivers gain Losing Ground as normal for failing to match a speed increase.
opportunities: Resilience (op): Reduce the damage your vehicle suffers from this technique by 2.
Resilience (op)(op): You do not suffer the strife cost from this technique (the vehicle damage remains).

vehicle.name: Smoke and Mirrors
vehicle.flavor: A garage entrance. An off-ramp. A tunnel mouth. The best escapes start with a hard turn into somewhere the pursuers did not expect you to go. By the time they realize what happened, the gap has stretched from meters to memory.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As a Scheme action during a chase while you are being pursued, make a TN 5 Piloting (Swiftness) check. This technique requires suitable terrain to break line of sight: an alley, a garage, an off-ramp, a tunnel, or similar cover. The GM determines whether the environment supports the maneuver.

Effects:

If you succeed, the chase ends. You escape all pursuers. The GM describes how you slip away.

vehicle.name: Totaled
vehicle.flavor: There are clean ways to end a chase: a spike strip, a barricade, coordinated radio traffic. Then there is the way that ends with a fireball and paperwork. You are the paperwork kind of problem. A vehicle is a projectile. All it needs is the right trajectory.

vehicle.name: Activation:
vehicle.activation:
Activation:

As an Attack action during a chase while at range 0–1 of a target vehicle, make a Piloting (Power) check. The TN equals the current scene speed plus the target driver's Vigilance.

Effects:

If you succeed, the target vehicle suffers damage equal to twice the current scene speed (minus its armor value). Your vehicle suffers damage equal to the current scene speed (minus your vehicle's armor value). If the target vehicle reaches its damage threshold from this damage, it is violently knocked out of the chase. All occupants suffer a Critical Strike with severity equal to the current scene speed plus your bonus successes.
opportunities: Power (op)+: Reduce the damage your vehicle suffers by 1 per (op) spent this way.
